```lean
inductive Tensor : Type where
  | mk : Array Float → Tensor

def Tensor.data : Tensor → Array Float
  | Tensor.mk d => d

inductive OFTB : Type where
  | mk : Float → Nat → OFTB

def OFTB.fractal_scale : OFTB → Float
  | OFTB.mk s _ => s

def OFTB.dim : OFTB → Nat
  | OFTB.mk _ d => d

def OFTB.init (d : Nat) : OFTB :=
  OFTB.mk 0.70710678 d

def floatMul (a b : Float) : Float := a * b
def floatAdd (a b : Float) : Float := a + b
def floatHalf (a : Float) : Float := a * 0.5

def Array.getD (arr : Array Float) (i : Nat) (default : Float) : Float :=
  Nat.casesOn (Nat.decLt i arr.size).decide
    default
    (fun _ => arr.get (Fin.mk i (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le
      (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le
        (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le
          (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le
            (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le
              (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.lt_succ_self
                (Nat.le_refl (i + 1)))
              (Nat.le_refl (i + 1)))
            (Nat.le_refl (i + 1)))
          (Nat.le_refl (i + 1)))
        (Nat.le_refl (i + 1)))
      (Nat.le_refl arr.size))))

def Array.setD (arr : Array Float) (i : Nat) (v : Float) : Array Float :=
  ite (Nat.decLt i arr.size = true)
    (arr.set (Fin.mk i (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le
      (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le
        (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le
          (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le
            (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le
              (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.lt_succ_self
                (Nat.le_refl (i + 1)))
              (Nat.le_refl (i + 1)))
            (Nat.le_refl (i + 1)))
          (Nat.le_refl (i + 1)))
        (Nat.le_refl (i + 1)))
      (Nat.le_refl arr.size))))
    arr

def copySlice (src : Array Float) (start len : Nat) : Array Float :=
  Nat.rec
    (Array.mkEmpty len)
    (fun i acc =>
      let idx := start + (len - Nat.succ i)
      Array.push acc (src.getD idx 0.0))
    len

def applyForwardX1 (x1 x2 : Array Float) (scale : Float) (i : Nat) : Array Float :=
  Nat.rec
    x1
    (fun j acc =>
      let idx := i - Nat.succ j
      let v1 := acc.getD idx 0.0
      let v2 := x2.getD idx 0.0
      Array.setD acc idx (floatAdd v1 (floatMul v2 scale)))
    i

def applyForwardX2 (x2 mix : Array Float) (scale : Float) (i : Nat) : Array Float :=
  Nat.rec
    x2
    (fun j acc =>
      let idx := i - Nat.succ j
      let v2 := acc.getD idx 0.0
      let vm := mix.getD idx 0.0
      Array.setD acc idx (floatAdd v2 (floatMul (floatMul vm scale) 0.5)))
    i

def mergeArrays (front back : Array Float) : Array Float :=
  Array.foldl (fun acc v => Array.push acc v) front back

def OFTB.forwardInPlace (self : OFTB) (x : Tensor) : Tensor :=
  let data := x.data
  let half := self.dim
  let scale := self.fractal_scale
  let limit := 16384
  ite (Nat.decLt (half * 2) (data.size + 1) = true)
    (ite (Nat.decLt limit half = false)
      (let x1raw := copySlice data 0 half
       let x2raw := copySlice data half half
       let mix   := copySlice data 0 half
       let x1new := applyForwardX1 x1raw x2raw scale half
       let x2new := applyForwardX2 x2raw mix scale half
       let front := Nat.rec
         x1new
         (fun i acc => acc)
         0
       let merged := mergeArrays x1new x2new
       let rest   := copySlice data (half * 2) (data.size - half * 2)
       let full   := mergeArrays merged rest
       Tensor.mk full)
      x)
    x

def applyBackwardG2 (g1 g2 : Array Float) (scale : Float) (i : Nat) : Array Float :=
  Nat.rec
    g2
    (fun j acc =>
      let idx := i - Nat.succ j
      let v2 := acc.getD idx 0.0
      let v1 := g1.getD idx 0.0
      Array.setD acc idx (floatAdd v2 (floatMul v1 scale)))
    i

def applyBackwardG1 (g1 buf : Array Float) (scale : Float) (i : Nat) : Array Float :=
  Nat.rec
    g1
    (fun j acc =>
      let idx := i - Nat.succ j
      let v1 := acc.getD idx 0.0
      let vb := buf.getD idx 0.0
      Array.setD acc idx (floatAdd v1 (floatMul (floatMul vb scale) 0.5)))
    i

def OFTB.backwardInPlace (self : OFTB) (grad : Array Float) : Array Float :=
  let half := self.dim
  let scale := self.fractal_scale
  let limit := 16384
  ite (Nat.decLt (half * 2) (grad.size + 1) = true)
    (ite (Nat.decLt limit half = false)
      (let g1raw := copySlice grad 0 half
       let g2raw := copySlice grad half half
       let buf   := copySlice grad half half
       let g2new := applyBackwardG2 g1raw g2raw scale half
       let g1new := applyBackwardG1 g1raw buf scale half
       let merged := mergeArrays g1new g2new
       let rest   := copySlice grad (half * 2) (grad.size - half * 2)
       mergeArrays merged rest)
      grad)
    grad

theorem OFTB_init_fractal_scale_correct (d : Nat) :
    (OFTB.init d).fractal_scale = 0.70710678 :=
  Eq.refl 0.70710678

theorem OFTB_init_dim_correct (d : Nat) :
    (OFTB.init d).dim = d :=
  Eq.refl d

theorem OFTB_init_mk_eq (d : Nat) :
    OFTB.init d = OFTB.mk 0.70710678 d :=
  Eq.refl (OFTB.mk 0.70710678 d)

theorem OFTB_fractal_scale_of_mk (s : Float) (d : Nat) :
    (OFTB.mk s d).fractal_scale = s :=
  Eq.refl s

theorem OFTB_dim_of_mk (s : Float) (d : Nat) :
    (OFTB.mk s d).dim = d :=
  Eq.refl d

theorem Tensor_data_of_mk (arr : Array Float) :
    (Tensor.mk arr).data = arr :=
  Eq.refl arr

theorem floatMul_comm_scale (a b : Float) :
    floatMul a b = a * b :=
  Eq.refl (a * b)

theorem floatAdd_comm_add (a b : Float) :
    floatAdd a b = a + b :=
  Eq.refl (a + b)

theorem floatHalf_is_half (a : Float) :
    floatHalf a = a * 0.5 :=
  Eq.refl (a * 0.5)

theorem copySlice_zero_len (src : Array Float) (start : Nat) :
    copySlice src start 0 = Array.mkEmpty 0 :=
  Eq.refl (Array.mkEmpty 0)

theorem mergeArrays_def (front back : Array Float) :
    mergeArrays front back = Array.foldl (fun acc v => Array.push acc v) front back :=
  Eq.refl (Array.foldl (fun acc v => Array.push acc v) front back)

theorem applyForwardX1_zero (x1 x2 : Array Float) (scale : Float) :
    applyForwardX1 x1 x2 scale 0 = x1 :=
  Eq.refl x1

theorem applyForwardX2_zero (x2 mix : Array Float) (scale : Float) :
    applyForwardX2 x2 mix scale 0 = x2 :=
  Eq.refl x2

theorem applyBackwardG2_zero (g1 g2 : Array Float) (scale : Float) :
    applyBackwardG2 g1 g2 scale 0 = g2 :=
  Eq.refl g2

theorem applyBackwardG1_zero (g1 buf : Array Float) (scale : Float) :
    applyBackwardG1 g1 buf scale 0 = g1 :=
  Eq.refl g1

theorem applyForwardX1_succ (x1 x2 : Array Float) (scale : Float) (n : Nat) :
    applyForwardX1 x1 x2 scale (Nat.succ n) =
      let prev := applyForwardX1 x1 x2 scale n
      let idx := n
      let v1 := prev.getD idx 0.0
      let v2 := x2.getD idx 0.0
      Array.setD prev idx (floatAdd v1 (floatMul v2 scale)) :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem applyForwardX2_succ (x2 mix : Array Float) (scale : Float) (n : Nat) :
    applyForwardX2 x2 mix scale (Nat.succ n) =
      let prev := applyForwardX2 x2 mix scale n
      let idx := n
      let v2 := prev.getD idx 0.0
      let vm := mix.getD idx 0.0
      Array.setD prev idx (floatAdd v2 (floatMul (floatMul vm scale) 0.5)) :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem applyBackwardG2_succ (g1 g2 : Array Float) (scale : Float) (n : Nat) :
    applyBackwardG2 g1 g2 scale (Nat.succ n) =
      let prev := applyBackwardG2 g1 g2 scale n
      let idx := n
      let v2 := prev.getD idx 0.0
      let v1 := g1.getD idx 0.0
      Array.setD prev idx (floatAdd v2 (floatMul v1 scale)) :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem applyBackwardG1_succ (g1 buf : Array Float) (scale : Float) (n : Nat) :
    applyBackwardG1 g1 buf scale (Nat.succ n) =
      let prev := applyBackwardG1 g1 buf scale n
      let idx := n
      let v1 := prev.getD idx 0.0
      let vb := buf.getD idx 0.0
      Array.setD prev idx (floatAdd v1 (floatMul (floatMul vb scale) 0.5)) :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem OFTB_forward_small_data_identity (self : OFTB) (x : Tensor) :
    Nat.decLt (self.dim * 2) (x.data.size + 1) = false →
    OFTB.forwardInPlace self x = x :=
  fun h =>
    let eq1 : OFTB.forwardInPlace self x =
      ite (Nat.decLt (self.dim * 2) (x.data.size + 1) = true) _ x :=
      Eq.refl _
    Eq.trans eq1 (ite_false _ _ (fun heq => absurd heq (fun contra => absurd h (Eq.symm contra ▸ (fun hf => absurd hf id)))))

theorem OFTB_backward_small_grad_identity (self : OFTB) (grad : Array Float) :
    Nat.decLt (self.dim * 2) (grad.size + 1) = false →
    OFTB.backwardInPlace self grad = grad :=
  fun h =>
    let eq1 : OFTB.backwardInPlace self grad =
      ite (Nat.decLt (self.dim * 2) (grad.size + 1) = true) _ grad :=
      Eq.refl _
    Eq.trans eq1 (ite_false _ _ (fun heq => absurd heq (fun contra => absurd h (Eq.symm contra ▸ (fun hf => absurd hf id)))))

theorem OFTB_forward_large_buf_identity (self : OFTB) (x : Tensor)
    (hsize : Nat.decLt (self.dim * 2) (x.data.size + 1) = true)
    (hbuf : Nat.decLt 16384 self.dim = true) :
    OFTB.forwardInPlace self x = x :=
  let outer : OFTB.forwardInPlace self x =
    ite (Nat.decLt (self.dim * 2) (x.data.size + 1) = true)
      (ite (Nat.decLt 16384 self.dim = false) _ x)
      x := Eq.refl _
  Eq.trans outer
    (ite_true _ _ hsize ▸
      ite_false _ _ (fun h => absurd h (Eq.symm hbuf ▸ (fun hf => absurd hf id))))

theorem OFTB_backward_large_buf_identity (self : OFTB) (grad : Array Float)
    (hsize : Nat.decLt (self.dim * 2) (grad.size + 1) = true)
    (hbuf : Nat.decLt 16384 self.dim = true) :
    OFTB.backwardInPlace self grad = grad :=
  let outer : OFTB.backwardInPlace self grad =
    ite (Nat.decLt (self.dim * 2) (grad.size + 1) = true)
      (ite (Nat.decLt 16384 self.dim = false) _ grad)
      grad := Eq.refl _
  Eq.trans outer
    (ite_true _ _ hsize ▸
      ite_false _ _ (fun h => absurd h (Eq.symm hbuf ▸ (fun hf => absurd hf id))))

theorem OFTB_init_scale_is_sqrt2_inv (d : Nat) :
    (OFTB.init d).fractal_scale = 0.70710678 :=
  Eq.refl 0.70710678

theorem OFTB_forward_returns_tensor (self : OFTB) (x : Tensor) :
    ∃ t : Tensor, OFTB.forwardInPlace self x = t :=
  Exists.intro (OFTB.forwardInPlace self x) (Eq.refl _)

theorem OFTB_backward_returns_array (self : OFTB) (grad : Array Float) :
    ∃ g : Array Float, OFTB.backwardInPlace self grad = g :=
  Exists.intro (OFTB.backwardInPlace self grad) (Eq.refl _)

theorem mergeArrays_push_foldl (front back : Array Float) :
    mergeArrays front back = Array.foldl Array.push front back :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem OFTB_dim_preserved_by_init (d : Nat) :
    (OFTB.init d).dim = d :=
  Eq.refl d

theorem floatMul_half_factor (x scale : Float) :
    floatMul (floatMul x scale) 0.5 = x * scale * 0.5 :=
  Eq.refl (x * scale * 0.5)

theorem applyForwardX1_one (x1 x2 : Array Float) (scale : Float) :
    applyForwardX1 x1 x2 scale 1 =
      let v1 := x1.getD 0 0.0
      let v2 := x2.getD 0 0.0
      Array.setD x1 0 (floatAdd v1 (floatMul v2 scale)) :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem applyForwardX2_one (x2 mix : Array Float) (scale : Float) :
    applyForwardX2 x2 mix scale 1 =
      let v2 := x2.getD 0 0.0
      let vm := mix.getD 0 0.0
      Array.setD x2 0 (floatAdd v2 (floatMul (floatMul vm scale) 0.5)) :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem applyBackwardG2_one (g1 g2 : Array Float) (scale : Float) :
    applyBackwardG2 g1 g2 scale 1 =
      let v2 := g2.getD 0 0.0
      let v1 := g1.getD 0 0.0
      Array.setD g2 0 (floatAdd v2 (floatMul v1 scale)) :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem applyBackwardG1_one (g1 buf : Array Float) (scale : Float) :
    applyBackwardG1 g1 buf scale 1 =
      let v1 := g1.getD 0 0.0
      let vb := buf.getD 0 0.0
      Array.setD g1 0 (floatAdd v1 (floatMul (floatMul vb scale) 0.5)) :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem OFTB_mk_components (s : Float) (d : Nat) :
    And ((OFTB.mk s d).fractal_scale = s) ((OFTB.mk s d).dim = d) :=
  And.intro (Eq.refl s) (Eq.refl d)

theorem Tensor_mk_data_roundtrip (arr : Array Float) :
    (Tensor.mk arr).data = arr :=
  Eq.refl arr

theorem copySlice_result_is_array (src : Array Float) (start len : Nat) :
    ∃ a : Array Float, copySlice src start len = a :=
  Exists.intro (copySlice src start len) (Eq.refl _)

theorem OFTB_forward_deterministic (self : OFTB) (x : Tensor) :
    OFTB.forwardInPlace self x = OFTB.forwardInPlace self x :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem OFTB_backward_deterministic (self : OFTB) (grad : Array Float) :
    OFTB.backwardInPlace self grad = OFTB.backwardInPlace self grad :=
  Eq.refl _

theorem OFTB_init_two_dims_distinct (d1 d2 : Nat) (h : d1 ≠ d2) :
    (OFTB.init d1).dim ≠ (OFTB.init d2).dim :=
  fun heq => absurd heq h

theorem applyForwardX1_induction (x1 x2 : Array Float) (scale : Float) (n : Nat) :
    ∃ result : Array Float, applyForwardX1 x1 x2 scale n = result :=
  Nat.rec
    (Exists.intro x1 (Eq.refl x1))
    (fun k ih =>
      let prev := applyForwardX1 x1 x2 scale k
      let idx := k
```
